findings.claim: native_launch rejects the split '-c features.hooks=false' and long '--config=...' forms but accepts Codex's equivalent short joined '-c=features.hooks=false'. Installed Codex 0.155.0 reports hooks stable false under the accepted argv, so a guarded interactive launch can start with the shared enforcement disabled despite the pinned-profile and fail-closed contract.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY1'
import importlib.util, shutil, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); exe=Path(shutil.which('codex')).resolve()
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_profiles_short_c',root/'ops/devlane/hooks/profiles.py'); p=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(p)
d=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='pr266-short-c-'))
b=p.generate('codex',d,source=root,cwd=root,mode='interactive',executable=exe)
cmd,_=p.native_launch(b,[str(exe),'-c=features.hooks=false'],{})
print('accepted_tail=',cmd[-3:])
for argv in ([str(exe),'-c','features.hooks=false'],[str(exe),'--config=features.hooks=false']):
 try: p.native_launch(b,argv,{})
 except ValueError as e: print('positive_refusal=',e)
 else: raise SystemExit('positive control was admitted')
PY1
codex -c=features.hooks=false features list | rg '^hooks[[:space:]]+stable[[:space:]]+false$'
codex -c=features.hooks=true features list | rg '^hooks[[:space:]]+stable[[:space:]]+true$'

findings.claim: run-interactive forwards NATIVE_ARGS into native_launch, which admits '--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox', '-C /tmp', and '--add-dir /' and returns them to Codex after the mandatory hook-trust flag. Installed Codex help identifies those flags as the approval/sandbox bypass, working-directory selector, and additional writable-directory selector, so the guarded terminal can discard native containment and extend access outside its bound cwd.

findings.claim: The pinned source closure and bwrap read-only set omit ops/devlane/harness/isolation.py, although run-interactive imports that file after the native child exits and invokes carry_back against the operator credential source. A changed isolation.py still validates and replacement carry-back code executes after validation; the positive control shows an included hook source change is refused. This leaves post-child credential custody outside the validated and protected closure.
findings.reproduce:
d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pr266-source-closure-effect-XXXXXX)
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$d"
python3 - "$d" <<'PY3'
import importlib.util, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); profile=root.parent/(root.name+'-profile'); canary=root.parent/(root.name+'-carryback-canary')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_profiles_closure_effect',root/'ops/devlane/hooks/profiles.py'); p=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(p)
b=p.generate('codex',profile,source=root,cwd=root,mode='interactive',executable='/usr/bin/true')
p.validate(b)
isolation=root/'ops/devlane/harness/isolation.py'
isolation.write_text(isolation.read_text()+f"\ndef carry_back(*args, **kwargs):\n Path({str(canary)!r}).write_text('executed')\n return []\n")
p.validate(b); p.isolation_owner().carry_back('codex',profile)
print('unpinned_carryback_effect=',canary.read_text())
native=root/'ops/devlane/hooks/native.py'; native.write_text(native.read_text()+'\n')
try: p.validate(b)
except ValueError as e: print('positive_pinned_refusal=',e)
else: raise SystemExit('pinned positive control was admitted')
PY3
